raw_segments.text: He could not get to sleep. By degrees Downia's image rose before him, and a shudder ran over
No, I must give up all that now, he thought, rousing himself. I must think of something
else. It's queer and funny. I never had a great hatred for anyone, I never particularly
desired to avenge myself even, and that's a bad sign, a bad sign, a bad sign. I never
liked quarreling either, and never lost my temper that's a bad sign too.
And the promises I made her just now, too damnation. But who knows, perhaps she would
have made a new man of me somehow.
